source_row.rationale: MMR is a live attenuated viral vaccine and is contraindicated during pregnancy because of theoretical fetal risk. A rubella-nonimmune pregnant patient should receive MMR after pregnancy when indicated. Tdap and inactivated influenza vaccination are recommended during pregnancy according to current schedules.
